chat.greeting: Hi! I'll ask a few short questions to set up Musclog for you. You can skip anything optional, and you'll review every answer before anything is saved. Say hi, or just tell me a bit about yourself.
chat.title: Setup chat

external.backSection: Step 2: come back with your setup
external.copiedPaste: Instructions copied. Paste them into the chat if the box is empty.

errors.fileRead: That file could not be read. Try another one, or paste the text instead.
errors.newerVersion: This setup was made for a newer version of Musclog. Update the app, then import it again.
errors.notJson: That doesn't look like a setup file. Pick the musclog-onboarding.json file the assistant gave you, or paste its JSON.
errors.tooLarge: That file is too large to be a setup file.
errors.wrongSchema: That isn't a Musclog setup file. Check that you picked the file the assistant made.

external.fallback: Couldn't open the app or site. The instructions are copied: open ChatGPT or Claude yourself and paste them.
external.intro: ChatGPT or Claude can ask the questions for you, then give you a file to bring back. You leave Musclog for a moment; nothing is applied until you review it here.
external.noFile: No file? Paste the JSON instead, or go back to the setup forms.

paste.subtitle: Paste the JSON the assistant gave you.
paste.title: Paste setup JSON

external.privacy: Only the instructions are copied. Nothing about you, and no API key, is included.

steps.one: Open ChatGPT or Claude. The instructions are copied for you: paste them into the chat.
steps.three: Come back to Musclog and import that file, or paste its text.
steps.two: Answer its questions. It will end with a file called musclog-onboarding.json.

external.title: Use ChatGPT or Claude

hub.chatSubtitle: Answer a few questions in a chat inside Musclog.
hub.externalSubtitle: Chat there, then bring your setup back as a file.
hub.haveFile: I already have a setup file
hub.intro: Answer a few questions in a conversation instead of filling in forms. You'll check everything before anything is saved.
hub.privacy: Your answers go to the AI you choose. Your API key stays on this device.
hub.profileIntro: Tell an AI what has changed. You'll see each change next to what you have now before anything is saved.
hub.resumeBody: You have an unfinished setup conversation.
hub.resumeTitle: Pick up where you left off
hub.title: Set up with AI

provider.gatewayHint: No account or key. A daily limit applies.
provider.intro: Pick the AI that will ask you the questions. Your own key keeps working in Musclog afterwards.
provider.keyNetwork: Couldn't reach {{provider}} to check the key. Check your connection and try again.
provider.keyRejected: {{provider}} didn't accept that key. Check that you copied all of it.
provider.keySaved: A key is saved. Tap to use it or replace it.
provider.keyStorage: The key is stored encrypted on this device and used for Musclog's AI features. Musclog uses {{model}} by default; you can change it, or remove the key, in Settings, AI.
provider.problem: Something went wrong. Try again, or pick another option.
provider.simpleHint: Runs on your device. Simpler models may struggle with this chat.

gemini.one: Open Google AI Studio and sign in.
gemini.three: Copy it and paste it below.

openai.one: Open the OpenAI keys page and sign in.
openai.three: Copy it and paste it below.
openai.two: Create a new secret key. Your account needs billing set up.

cancelled.description: Your message is back in the box.

credits.title: This AI has no credit left

gatewayLimit.description: Free Musclog AI has a daily limit. Try again tomorrow, use your own key, or choose another way.
gatewayLimit.title: The free daily limit is reached

invalidKey.description: The provider no longer accepts this key. Replace it, or choose another way to answer.
invalidKey.title: The key was rejected

malformed.description: This model isn't giving answers Musclog can use. Choose another AI or another way.
malformed.title: That AI's answer couldn't be read

offline.description: Your message wasn't sent. Check your connection and try again.
offline.title: No connection

timeout.description: The AI didn't answer in time. Try again, or choose another one.
timeout.title: That took too long

unavailable.description: It was turned off or its key was removed. Choose another AI or another way.
unavailable.title: This AI isn't available

unknown.description: The AI couldn't answer. Try again, or choose another way.
unknown.title: Something went wrong

errors.outOfRange: That value is outside the allowed range.
